axis: bare classification by sex → a person defined by her tie to a particular man

members.tone: Fixes a person by her attachment to one man and leaves the exact tie open — wife, mistress or girlfriend all answer to it — which is the possessive edge *female* has none of.
Marks youth and nothing else, saying nothing about who she is to anyone, unlike *woman* here.
Flat classification by the sex that bears children, carrying neither the age of *girl* nor the relational claim of *woman*.
